purpose: Finite exposed four-phase coordination discovery: sixteen recovery bodies, fourteen geometry-derived sequences, a fresh timed comparator and brake. Distinct wind-up, drive, follow-through and catch targets use measured pose/progress/contact transitions and bounded fallback. No recovery qualification or learning claim.
not_covered: Other fallen orientations or varied initial velocities in this cohort
Weakened motors, impacts, terrain or held-out robustness
Learning, training-data authority, useful online memory, real-time behavior or release

body_selection.method: Retain all 16 bodies from the first righting breadth declaration in its fixed farthest-point descriptor order; no outcome selects or removes a body.

coverage: All inherited 134 safety controls plus nine sequence controls; zero physics before the complete gate.
Every candidate retains the same normalized target, velocity, slew, force and joint bounds, physical initialization, full capture and terminal upright criterion.
Independent scalar replay reconstructs phase state, delays and measured mechanics; the native reader reconstructs sampled work from the original internal-step stream.
256 fresh six-second worlds: sixteen bodies times sixteen profiles, one inverted start. No cached physical comparator or learned selector.

profile_factorization.interpretation: Within each family, the timed and feedback variants share poses, gain, speed and slew bounds. Feedback uses measured body-frame angular rate, a 0.2-second minimum hold and a two-second fallback. Opposite polarities and optional distal-contact gating are exposed development candidates, not learned policies.

proposal_provenance.rule: Equal-weight mean of all sixteen retained height tables. Opposite-direction 0..5-degree slope for wind-up, intended-direction 15..20 for drive, and 90..95 for follow-through. Require mean pose distance >= 0.15 between selected poses and >= 0.05 from neutral for wind-up/follow-through. Lowest index within 1e-12 of the eligible minimum wins. Neutral catch is appended.
proposal_provenance.phase_population: All eight azimuths receive synchronous phases; the six non-lateral azimuths also receive the declared front/hind and diagonal delays. All sixteen bodies are retained without outcome selection.

qualification_economy: New controller state and observable: four non-complementary pose phases, delayed limb release, measured transition gates, whole-body angular momentum/kinetic energy, and a force-displacement work estimate. Shared controller, containment, worker and scalar reader are reused; nine focused controls cover the new semantics.
mechanics_scope: Generalized measured state and compiled masses/inertias reconstruct body momentum and kinetic energy. Completed-step joint-actuator force multiplied by measured joint displacement is an explicitly sampled work estimate; it is not exact continuous work, a closed energy balance or an eligibility criterion.
diversity_scope: The unchanged 0.15 mean normalized pose-distance threshold compares target sequences on a common equal-phase grid. Two-pose comparisons retain their original order and arithmetic. Timing differences alone do not create pose diversity.
